text:
Marta (Product): @channel quick update: we are GA-ing the mosaicx-moderation endpoint for hosted API customers tomorrow at 09:00 PT. This provides unified content safety signals (severity + categories) and a streaming moderation mode for low-latency classification. Please skim the rollout notes below and escalate any blockers. :white_check_mark:

Ethan (Eng): Nice. Any client changes required?

Marta (Product): Minimal. New endpoint: `POST /v1/moderation/mosaicx`. Existing moderation params remain except we add `stream=true` for streaming judgments and `policy_level` with values `standard` (default) or `strict`. Example (non-stream):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/moderation/mosaicx" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"I want to harm someone","policy_level":"strict"}'
```

Priya (Trust & Safety): Important callout: `strict` enforces tighter thresholds and will block more content by default. For customers that previously used permissive filters, expect an increase in auto-block actions if they switch to `strict`. We'll run customer-facing guidance in the migration note.

Asha (Docs): Docs PR is ready: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/4390 12 includes migration guide, streaming examples for node/python, and a FAQ about differences vs legacy moderation endpoints. I'll publish at deploy time.

Marco (SRE): Ops notes: deploy windows = us-west-2 then global. Canary = 20m. Abort if error rate increases >2x or streaming disconnect rate >1%. Streaming retention: we keep moderation streams ephemeral; no content is stored beyond policy window unless flagged. Health checks will post to #eng-oncall. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/moderation-ga.

Ethan (Eng): What about rate limits and quotas? Streaming moderations could add connection churn.

Marta (Product): Rate limit changes: we add a per-connection stream slot (counted separately) and a 1k req/min per-key cap for non-streamed moderation. Customers on legacy plans will be auto-migrated to the same quotas; enterprise can request higher through support. Billing note: non-stream moderation counts are cheap (0.01 unit), streaming judged per-message at 0.002 units. We'll publish precise numbers in the pricing doc.

Priya (Trust & Safety): Privacy note: customers who enable streaming should disclose ephemeral content handling in their TOS. We surfaced a short legal blurb in the migration doc. LegalBot: automated review passed for EU data flow constraints.

LegalBot: Automated compliance scan OK 10. No high-risk issues detected for hosted GA.

Asha (Docs): I'll add a short troubleshooting section (common false positives, guidance for toggling `policy_level`, and example webhook payloads for flagged content).

Marta (Product): Action items: Eng and SRE watch canary metrics and streaming disconnects during first 30m; Docs publish migration note at go-time; Trust & Safety monitor any uplift in block rates and open a ticket for high false-positive customers. We'll send a customer-facing email after 24h with initial metrics.

Marco (SRE): DeployBot scheduled job md-197223. Canary started -> logs will be posted here.

DeployBot: Canary job md-197223 started at 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/md-197223/logs

Marco (SRE): Canary +10m: streaming p50 45ms, disconnects 0.3%, errors flat. Proceeding to global rollout in 5m.

Ethan (Eng): Observability hooks added to Console: moderation traffic per-key, stream connections, and per-policy_level block rates.

Priya (Trust & Safety): Early signal: for customers using `strict`, block rate up ~28% on toxic content category, but false positive rate stable. We'll follow up if false positives increase.

Asha (Docs): Published: /docs/moderation/mosaicx-ga and added migration note to the release email template.

DeployBot: Global rollout complete. Canary and regional windows closed.

Marta (Product): Thanks team. We'll share a short GA summary and usage/cost impact in 48h. If you notice customer regressions tag @Priya and @Marco.

Ethan (Eng): :rocket:

Priya (Trust & Safety): Thanks all. Monitoring active.
